name: pl_fake_ingestion
description: Hourly pipeline that calls the GetFlightData Azure Function to ingest the equivalent 2022 hour into the live_feed landing zone. Triggered at :05 past each hour.

setup_steps: Prerequisites (already done in Phase 1): func-flight-ingest deployed in rg-tfm-flight; Managed Identity has Member access on TFM_Flight_Prediction workspace; cloud POST returns status: ok.
1. Get the default host key: Azure Portal → func-flight-ingest → Functions → App keys → default (host key) → copy.
2. In Fabric → TFM_Flight_Prediction → New → Data pipeline → 'pl_fake_ingestion'.
3. Reproduce the Web Activity from this JSON (Fabric does not support raw JSON import — use this file as a blueprint).
4. Override FunctionKey at pipeline run time, or store the key in a Fabric Variable Library / Azure Key Vault linked service.
5. Run nb_backfill_buffer FIRST to populate 168 partitions in live_feed/rolling_buffer/.
6. After backfill, enable the hourly :05 UTC trigger on this pipeline.
7. Verify within 70 minutes: a new partition appears in live_feed/rolling_buffer/YYYY/MM/DD/HH/.
